data.obligation: Required to build, operate, and provide access to electronic communications network infrastructure in South Africa. Vcom must hold a valid ECNS licence issued by ICASA.
data.update_frequency: Licence conditions reviewed periodically; check for gazette amendments

data.obligation: Governs processes for obtaining wayleave permits, accessing public and private property for network deployment, and resolving access disputes. Ensures uniform municipal approval processes for infrastructure rollout.
data.update_frequency: Regulation currently under revision (2025-2026 policy cycle)

data.obligation: Under the Electronic Communications Act, FNOs may be required to provide open access to infrastructure to reduce duplication. Vcom must comply with any sharing directives.

data.body: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies (DCDT)
data.obligation: National broadband rollout policy. FNOs participating in government-funded connectivity programmes must align to SA Connect targets and compliance standards.
data.update_frequency: Annual policy reviews; quarterly progress reports

data.body: USAASA (Universal Service and Access Agency of South Africa)
data.obligation: USAASA funds connectivity projects in underserved areas. FNOs tendering for USAASA contracts must meet eligibility and reporting requirements.
FNOs operating captive portals, subscriber authentication systems, or NOC/monitoring platforms collecting user data must comply with POPIA data processing and storage obligations.

Each municipality has its own wayleave process for permission to install aerial infrastructure on poles, street furniture, or in road reserves. Major municipalities: eThekwini, City of Johannesburg, City of Tshwane, City of Cape Town, Ekurhuleni.
data.monitoring_url: Each municipality's infrastructure or planning department
data.update_frequency: Application-based; bylaws may change with new councils
